paragraphs.source_en: At dawn on the twenty-ninth day of the third month of Keichō 16, Lady Yodo at last fell into a deep sleep. The previous night, she had summoned Senhime and talked late into the night with several of the women who had remained behind. After everyone had withdrawn, Lady Yodo tossed and turned, unable to sleep, and did not close her eyes until dawn was near. Her sleeplessness had not begun that year; every year at this season, Lady Yodo found herself unable to sleep.
